$Comment: What each member of the Great Turkey's fight is told as each wave of Turkey Souls rises around the
Turkey Graveyard's fountain, before the Great Turkey wakes (the fight's GuardWave, Zc_Wave_Chain, draws
it). Args 'wave' is the wave's number in the run, which the chain hands every moment it draws. Keys are
lines in this pack's harvestfeast.progression.lang, written bare. The file name is the moment id.
